title: Christmas Light Installation
shortDescription: Custom-designed, commercial-grade LED Christmas light installation for homes and businesses across the GTA — no ladders, no tangled wires, no stress.
longDescription: Our designers visit your property, plan a one-of-a-kind display, and our certified install team brings it to life. We use commercial-grade LED bulbs (97% less electricity than retail), custom-cut strands to your roofline, and timers programmed for sunset-on / dawn-off. Every install is backed by our Perfect-Until-Christmas-Eve Guarantee.
imageAlt: Professional Christmas light installation on luxury Toronto home by GTA Christmas Lights

title: Custom Lighting Design
shortDescription: Award-winning designers create a holiday lighting plan tailored to your home's architecture, landscape, and personal style.
longDescription: Three Landscape Ontario Awards of Excellence speak for themselves. Our designers spend 2–4 hours on site measuring rooflines, mapping power sources, photographing key features, and rendering a custom plan. From classic warm-white to bold multicolor, every detail is intentional.
imageAlt: Award of Excellence holiday lighting design by GTA Christmas Lights

title: Wreaths & Garlands
shortDescription: Hand-decorated lit wreaths, custom garlands on pillars, railings, and doorways for a complete holiday look.
longDescription: Beyond rooflines, we transform front entrances with fresh-look greenery, lit garlands on pillars and railings, oversized lit wreaths with custom ribbons, and decorative bows. Commercial-grade greenery that holds up to GTA winters and stores beautifully for next year.
imageAlt: Custom lit Christmas wreath with pinecones and gold ribbon installed by GTA Christmas Lights

title: Tree & Shrub Lighting
shortDescription: From wrapped spruces to spiral-wrapped trunks and lit shrubs — we light the entire landscape, not just the roof.
longDescription: Large evergreens get up to 3,500 lights, wrapped branch-by-branch for a 360° glow. Smaller shrubs get even-cast wraps that look stunning from the street. Spiral-wrapped trunks make a refined statement that DIY just can't match.
imageAlt: Spiral-wrapped Christmas tree lighting by GTA Christmas Lights

title: Interior Holiday Decorating
shortDescription: Christmas trees, mantels, staircases, and entertaining spaces decorated with a designer's eye and white-glove install.
longDescription: Our interior team styles your home for the holidays — fresh or premium-faux Christmas trees, garlanded mantels and banisters, table-scapes, and statement pieces. Perfect for entertaining season. We deliver, install, refresh, and remove.
imageAlt: Interior Christmas decorating service in a Toronto home by GTA Christmas Lights

title: Commercial & Property Displays
shortDescription: Hospitals, hotels, restaurants, retail centres, and condo lobbies — large-scale holiday lighting installed safely with aerial equipment.
longDescription: We've designed and installed for St. Joseph's Hospital, the CNE, Locale Restaurant, and Netflix productions. Insured, WSIB-covered, certified for aerial platforms and working-at-heights. We handle traffic plans, after-hours installs, and multi-day projects.
imageAlt: Large-scale commercial Christmas lighting installation at the CNE by GTA Christmas Lights

title: Maintenance, Takedown & Storage
shortDescription: Lights stop working? We're on it. After the season, we remove, label, and store everything so next year is effortless.
longDescription: Our Perfect-Until-Christmas-Eve Guarantee means we proactively check your display and respond fast to any issue. Post-season, we carefully take everything down, inventory every component, and store it in climate-controlled space — yours and ready to re-install next November.
imageAlt: Commercial-grade Christmas LED lights stored and maintained by GTA Christmas Lights
